WORKSHEET · CLASS 31 · AGES 4 YEARS

Bunny’s Plant Growth Lab Worksheet for Age 4

Seed, sprout, seedling, sunflower — write 1, 2, 3 and 4 to show how a plant grows.

THE WORKSHEET

The full sheet, exactly as it prints.

This page is the worksheet’s home: see the whole sheet, download it or print it, and pass it on. Solving on screen happens in the class’s own activities on the Learning Path — this page is for the table, the kitchen and the fridge door.

ABOUT THIS WORKSHEET

What your child practices.

Growth sequencing turns a science lesson into a story with four chapters. Numbering the stages asks your child to reason about TIME — what must happen before what — which is the same thinking that later makes history and recipes make sense.

  • Sequencing 4 growth stages
  • Number writing 1–4
  • First/next/then/last language
  • Noticing plant parts

On the sheet: Write 1, 2, 3, and 4 to show how a plant grows!

The class behind it.

What your child practices.

What your child practices.

Sink-or-float is the classic first experiment because the prediction feels brave and the test is instant. The material is the hidden clue — wood and cork trap air, metal and stone do not — and the bath confirms everything.
